findings.claim: The row only scrolls a card into view when a click or arrow key picks it (pick(id, true)). select() and show(), which game.showMenu() uses to restore the selection on every return to the menu, go through pick(id, false) and never scroll. In a row that scrolls, the checked (mustard) card can then sit outside the row's visible area, and RACE still starts it.
findings.evidence:
start-screen.ts:49-53 holds the only scrollIntoView call in src/, inside `if (focus && card.id === id)`. select() (115-119) ends in `pick(trackId, false)`; show() (105-113) only refresh()es, hands a re-locked selection to `pick(first.id, false)` and runs screen.show(). game.ts:314-315 runs `startScreen.select(menuTrack.id); startScreen.show();` on every return to the menu (QUIT TO MENU, results), and menuTrack follows NEXT RACE (game.ts:121).
Repro with the four registered tracks: set localStorage racer.finished.hay-loop=1 (Pine Ridge unlocked), use a 600×360 touch viewport (under 720px wide, the four 96px cards need 4×96+3×8 = 408px, more than the row's 2W/3−72 content width, so the row scrolls), then `__racer.startRace({track:'pine-ridge',seed:1}); __racer.showMenu()`. That is the same state as finishing Hay Loop, NEXT RACE, QUIT TO MENU. Result: the Pine Ridge radio has aria-checked=true but row.scrollLeft is 0; the row is 352px wide and the card spans x 324–420 in it, so 28 of its 96px show. In the eight-card stage at 844×390 a checked 7th card would span x 636–732 against a 514px row: fully hidden. Whether the browser keeps or resets scrollLeft while the overlay is hidden, nothing scrolls the checked card back in.
Should be: after show() the checked card lies inside the row. A happy-dom test can spy on Element.prototype.scrollIntoView, call select('x') then show(): it is never called.
findings.suggestedFix: In show(), after screen.show(), scroll the selected card into the row: `cards.find((c) => c.id === selected)?.element.scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' });`. It has to come after screen.show(), because scrollIntoView does nothing on the hidden overlay, which is why select() (called before show()) can't do it.

checked.how: Traced click and Enter/Space on a locked card: each cancels the old Animation, then makes one element.animate() with no fill, so at most one runs and it ends at identity. Reduced motion cancels and starts none. Unlocked cards still call onPick. preventDefault is only for unmodified Enter/Space on locked cards, so arrows still reach the group handler.

checked.how: keyboard.ts:55-62 also sees Space on the locked div (not in INTERACTIVE) and sets down/actionTapped. Nothing reads input in the menu and game.startRace calls input.reset() (game.ts:304), so the latch never reaches a race. Not reported.

checked.target: html, body { touch-action: none } (base.css:10) against the new scroll row
checked.how: Neither the row nor the cards set touch-action, and the tests set scrollLeft from script, so no test swipes the row. Whether Chromium starts a pan in a nested scroller under a touch-action:none ancestor can't be settled by reading, so it is not reported; a CDP touch-swipe test would settle it.
Diff touches no src/sim. Gates: bot laps +0.0%, 5 replays identical. No Date, Math.random, rAF or timers added; the only setTimeout stays in screen-change.ts.

checked.target: src/ui/screen-change.ts reducedMotion() export and its new importer
checked.how: Grep matchMedia/prefers-reduced-motion in src/: one definition, one new importer (track-card.ts), no import cycle. happy-dom 21.0.4 implements Element.animate and scrollIntoView, so the existing happy-dom clicks on Pine Ridge don't throw.

Deterministic: four registered cards plus four fixtures with fixed names, ids fixture-1..4 and mirrored outlines; registered by the *.stage.ts glob; imports only stage helpers and the start screen; Pine Ridge locked, first card selected.

checked.target: Events through overlays and touch zones
checked.how: screen-change.css:10 has pointer-events none, so taps reach cards during the sweep. touch-controls.ts measure() returns [] at zero size (line 128), so while the race layer is hidden the touch input swallows no menu taps.

AC1-AC7 each map to a test on real stages; grep finds no .skip/.only/@ts-ignore/eslint-disable/Date/Math.random. Shake checks read getAnimations() a few ms after the click inside the 250ms window; a CDP stall over 250ms would flake them, but I found no deterministic failure.

checked.target: Edge cases: zero, one and eight cards; arrow wrap; re-locked selection
checked.how: Empty tracks: no cards, selected null, group handler returns. One card: the arrow loop never runs. Wrap uses (i + step*k + n*k) % n. show() hands a re-locked selection to the first unlocked card (also without scrolling, see F1).

checked.target: UI_RULES §12 shake vs SHAKE/SHAKE_TIMING in track-card.ts, and the locked rest rule
checked.how: Keyframes 0, +s1, -s1, +s1, 0 px as translateX; duration tokens wipe (250); snap easing set on the effect; no fill; transform only. Matches AC3. title.css:207-212 keeps the locked card at rest on hover/active/focus-visible and comes after the lift rules (same specificity), so the shake never fights a lift.
